boundary.scope: Original physical B64 with63 live rows and original padding; layers0,19,39 x5 native routing distributions. No service/model claim.

baseline.implementation: original vendor prepared native complete MoE

candidate.implementation: M128 FC1/native activation/metadata-ready M128 FC2/native ordered finalizer

graph_contract.full: Controlled callback node deltas close over the complete capture; all metadata nodes precede FC1; original FC1→activation→FC2→finalizer PROGRAMMATIC edges retain ports1→0; add DEFAULT ports0→0 from every metadata producer to FC2; seal before instantiate, private graph/owners retained.
graph_contract.empty: Separate gemm_empty_probe; six complete live metadata tensors copied from retained mutable source buffers inside graph. ncta/padded0 then positive restoration then zero again on same graph, fixed nonzero grids. No native activation/finalizer; saved activation/scales ready before invocation. Not a full-MoE timing graph.
graph_contract.eager: Metadata callback followed by own event completion; single-use permit outside capture, full chain completed before permit release.
graph_contract.limitations: Trusted callbacks; snapshot verifies topology/launch attributes, not raw kernel argument payloads. No external raw graph mutation; retained storage identity is fixed while tensor contents may change.

ownership: GPU2 idle before every process; process-group scoped sampling each2s; terminate only own group on failure; post must become empty within5s. Other GPUs untouched.
stop: First exact/hash/owner/metric/count/timeout failure; no silent metric substitutions, retries, whole-graph or source changes. If recorded passes>4 stop before next process, preserving collected case.
